title: Green Goddess Dressing
summary: Mayonnaise and soured cream blended with parsley, tarragon, garlic, anchovy and lemon, finished with chives.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Put the mayonnaise, soured cream, parsley, tarragon, garlic, anchovy, lemon juice and water into the blender. Blend until smooth and pale green, scraping down the sides once.

steps.title: Add chives
steps.text: Scrape into a bowl and stir in the chives and pepper.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and chill for 30 min so the flavours come together.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon over crisp lettuce wedges or serve as a dip for raw vegetables.

tips: Pat the herbs dry so the dressing does not turn watery.
Thin with a spoonful of water for a pourable salad dressing.
Add more anchovy for a stronger savoury flavour.
Basil can replace some of the parsley.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
